hook.text: Tether (USDT) has a $120 billion market cap. It claims each token is backed by $1. It has never had a full public audit.

buildup.text: Stablecoins peg to a stable asset, usually the U.S. dollar. They bring price stability to the volatile crypto world.

discovery.text: Traders use stablecoins to park profits without cashing out to banks. They're the default settlement layer of crypto.

twist.text: TerraUSD was an algorithmic stablecoin. In May 2022, its $18 billion peg collapsed to zero in days. Algorithms can fail.

climax.text: Stablecoins process $8 trillion annually—more than Visa. They may be crypto's most practical and important invention.

punchline.text: A crypto dollar. Useful but trust-dependent.

quiz.question: What happened to the TerraUSD stablecoin in 2022?
options: Its $18 billion peg collapsed to zero
